and time-off bidding, card payment by phone, AI usage and spend limits, Teams and Zoom presence, SharePoint and OneDrive knowledge, field jobs for the mobile app, SAP S/4HANA and Business One, seven more industry templates, and the YAXXA omni look.

Overtime and time-off bidding: agents bid for extra hours or for going home early, and a rule (seniority, fewest overtime hours lately, or random) or a planner picks who gets it. Overtime can be offered on a day off, going home early is marked paid or unpaid, and a shift can be offered to anyone who can work it.

Card payment by phone: the caller keys their card number while the agent stays on the call and never hears or sees it. Built on payment links; switched off until an operator turns it on, and for now only with the staging test gateway.

AI usage and spend: see what your AI replies cost this billing cycle, by feature, model and AI agent, with a forecast and an export (AI → Usage & spend). Set a monthly or daily AI spend limit, overall or per feature, that warns or stops the AI so people take over, with spend alerts on your alert rules. Operators set model costs under Platform → Yaxxa AI → Model costs.

Teams and Zoom: agents in a Teams or Zoom meeting are not offered calls or chats, Teams shows agents on a customer call as busy, and agents can start a Zoom meeting from a conversation. It waits for a first live test with a customer's Teams or Zoom.

SharePoint and OneDrive knowledge: Word, Markdown and text files in the SharePoint or OneDrive folders you pick become knowledge articles, kept up to date every hour. It waits for a first live test with a customer's SharePoint.

Field jobs in the mobile app: field staff check in and out of a visit on a ticket and add photos and signatures to it; Mobile settings choose whether photos upload on Wi-Fi only, and their size.

SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business One: agents see the SAP customer on the desk, notes and activities are logged in SAP, and tickets stay in step with SAP service orders and service calls.

Industry templates: ready-made sets for Education and training, Hospitality and travel, Automotive, Property, Government, Media, and Manufacturing and agriculture. The template picker is grouped by job, industry and outsourcing.

Snag reports: operators switch the report-a-problem widget on or off per reseller, and organisations choose which roles may send reports; Help and Ask stay in the widget either way.

In-country recording: the Marketplace now lists keeping recordings in your own storage, in your region.

YAXXA omni look: the new YAXXA omni logo, a new landing page, a branded loading screen, and a lighter sign-in page lit by the brand's colour.

API reference: every operation has a summary and its response described, it opens fast with a search box, the tenant header can be set under Authorize, and nullable fields show their type.

Fixes: the platform console stays Yaxxa for platform admins who also run a reseller, and opening a tenant of a reseller whose name contains the brand name no longer freezes the page."}
